lines.zh: 我踏着梦魇第三层的暗影，缓慢逼近。
lines.en: I tread the shadows of the Nightmare's third layer, closing in slowly.

lines.zh: 每一步都让我离你更近，危险也更浓。
lines.en: Every step brings me closer, and the danger thicker.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的范围远比你想象的大。
lines.en: Don't run; my reach is far greater than you think.

lines.zh: 八格之内，你已经在我的猎场里了。
lines.en: Within eight blocks, you're already in my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可你逃不出这距离。
lines.en: I don't walk fast, but you can't escape this distance.

lines.zh: 靠近我，只会让我的力量更盛。
lines.en: Coming closer only makes my power swell.

lines.zh: 暗影随我行，杀意随我近。
lines.en: Shadow follows my stride, and killing intent follows my approach.

lines.zh: 我无需挥爪，距离就是我的爪。
lines.en: I need no claws; distance is my claw.

lines.zh: 梦魇的风送来了你的气息。
lines.en: The nightmare wind carries your scent to me.

lines.zh: 再近一步，你的痛就会翻倍。
lines.en: One more step closer, and your pain will double.

lines.zh: 我漫步于黑暗，你却在倒计时。
lines.en: I stroll through darkness while your countdown runs.

lines.zh: 别停，停下来我就贴到你脸上了。
lines.en: Don't stop; if you do, I'll be right in your face.

lines.zh: 暗影深处，我静静蓄着势。
lines.en: In the deep shadow, I quietly gather my strength.

lines.zh: 不动，不代表我够不着你。
lines.en: Standing still doesn't mean I can't reach you.

lines.zh: 梦魇第三层很安静，安静得正好。
lines.en: The third layer is quiet—quiet enough for me.

lines.zh: 我等着，等你走近那八格。
lines.en: I wait for you to step within those eight blocks.

lines.zh: 离我越近，你越该害怕。
lines.en: The closer you get, the more you should fear.

lines.zh: 珍珠的光，在远处微微闪。
lines.en: A pearl's gleam flickers faintly in the distance.

lines.zh: 我歇一会儿，杀意可没歇。
lines.en: I rest a moment; my killing intent doesn't.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的轮廓几乎看不见。
lines.en: In the dark, my outline is nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 你若站着不动，我也乐得省力。
lines.en: If you stand still, I'm happy to save effort.

lines.zh: 静默之中，距离在悄悄缩短。
lines.en: In the silence, the distance quietly shrinks.

lines.zh: 八格之内，你的呼吸都算靠近。
lines.en: Within eight blocks, even your breath counts as approach.

lines.zh: 再靠近点，我想看看你疼的样子。
lines.en: Come closer; I want to see you in pain.

lines.zh: 你的眼神在抖，我的杀意在涨。
lines.en: Your eyes tremble; my killing intent rises.

lines.zh: 八格，是你和我之间的生死线。
lines.en: Eight blocks—the line of life and death between us.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，也看见你身后的退路。
lines.en: I see you, and I see the retreat behind you.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神看我，走近些。
lines.en: Don't look at me like that—come closer.

lines.zh: 你越靠近，我越强，这很公平。
lines.en: The closer you are, the stronger I get; that's fair.

lines.zh: 梦魇的暗影里，你显得好小。
lines.en: In the nightmare's shadow, you look so small.

lines.zh: 我闻到了恐惧，就在你站的地方。
lines.en: I smell fear, right where you stand.

lines.zh: 看够了吗？再近一步试试。
lines.en: Seen enough? Try one more step closer.

lines.zh: 疼？暗影会替我记住这笔账。
lines.en: Pain? The shadow will remember this debt for me.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，但也只是打中。
lines.en: You hit me—but only hit me.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换不来你逃出八格。
lines.en: This little wound won't buy your escape from eight blocks.

lines.zh: 我退半步，范围可没退。
lines.en: I step back half a pace; my range doesn't.

lines.zh: 你敢动手，说明你离得够近。
lines.en: You dare strike, which means you're close enough.

lines.zh: 伤口在暗里，杀意在涨。
lines.en: The wound is in the dark; the killing intent rises.

lines.zh: 别高兴太早，我只是慢一点。
lines.en: Don't celebrate yet; I'm just a little slower.

lines.zh: 痛感让我更清楚你的位置。
lines.en: The pain makes your position clearer to me.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会用距离还你。
lines.en: This one, I'll repay with distance.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，可你还在我的圈里。
lines.en: I'm hurt, but you're still in my circle.

lines.zh: 食物？我只对缩短距离感兴趣。
lines.en: Food? I'm only interested in closing the gap.

lines.zh: 别拿吃的晃我，我更想吃掉距离。
lines.en: Don't wave food at me; I'd rather devour the distance.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不如你脚下的位置诱人。
lines.en: What's in your hand is less tempting than where you stand.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想看你再靠近一点。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I just want to see you come closer.

lines.zh: 食物引不开我，暗影才是我的胃口。
lines.en: Food can't lure me away; shadow is my appetite.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我只当是站近的借口。
lines.en: Whatever you offer, I take as an excuse to stand closer.

lines.zh: 别喂我，喂你自己一口恐惧吧。
lines.en: Don't feed me; feed yourself a bite of fear.

lines.zh: 我盯着的是你，不是你手里的玩意儿。
lines.en: I'm staring at you, not the thing in your hand.

lines.zh: 食物留不住我，距离才留得住你。
lines.en: Food won't hold me; distance will hold you.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就当你没带食物。
lines.en: Step back half a pace, and I'll pretend you brought nothing.

lines.zh: 撞上来了？正好，省得我再走。
lines.en: Bumped into me? Good—saves me a step.

lines.zh: 你贴得这么近，我的力量正翻涌。
lines.en: So close to me, my power is surging.

lines.zh: 碰撞也是靠近，靠近就是伤害。
lines.en: A collision is closeness, and closeness is harm.

lines.zh: 别推我，你推不开这层暗影。
lines.en: Don't push me; you can't push through this shadow.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的范围，就别想轻松出去。
lines.en: You crashed into my range; don't expect to leave easily.

lines.zh: 碰一下而已，疼的会是你。
lines.en: Just a touch—you'll be the one hurting.

lines.zh: 八格之内，碰撞只是开始。
lines.en: Within eight blocks, collision is only the beginning.

lines.zh: 你退开吧，越贴我越难收手。
lines.en: Back away; the closer you are, the harder I stop.

lines.zh: 暗影被我撞得晃了晃，你呢？
lines.en: The shadow shook from my bump—how about you?

lines.zh: 碰我就等于缩短你活着的距离。
lines.en: Touching me is the same as shortening your life's distance.

lines.zh: 交配？梦魇里没这回事。
lines.en: Mate? No such thing in the nightmare.

lines.zh: 我只对拉近距离有兴致。
lines.en: I'm only interested in closing distances.

lines.zh: 别靠过来求这个，我会当成靠近。
lines.en: Don't come asking for that; I'll take it as approach.

lines.zh: 暗影不繁衍，只吞噬。
lines.en: Shadow doesn't breed; it devours.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有猎物。
lines.en: I have no mate, only prey.

lines.zh: 这话题离我远点，你也是。
lines.en: Keep that topic far from me—and yourself too.

lines.zh: 第三层不兴这个，兴的是靠近就疼。
lines.en: The third layer doesn't do that; it does pain-on-approach.

lines.zh: 你提这个，不如提怎么逃出八格。
lines.en: Rather than that, talk about escaping eight blocks.

lines.zh: 我不配对，我只对距离感兴趣。
lines.en: I don't pair up; I care about distance.

lines.zh: 走开吧，我的心思全在缩短距离上。
lines.en: Walk away; my mind is all on closing the gap.

lines.zh: 这颗珍珠，是我猎场的战利品。
lines.en: This pearl is a trophy of my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 光亮的东西，我收着，不给别人。
lines.en: Shiny things—I keep them, not share them.

lines.zh: 拾起珍珠，暗影里多了一点光。
lines.en: Picking up the pearl adds a glint to the shadow.

lines.zh: 我捡它不为卖，只为记住谁倒下了。
lines.en: I pick it up not to sell, but to remember who fell.

lines.zh: 珍珠落在我爪边，正好归我。
lines.en: The pearl fell by my claw—it's mine now.

lines.zh: 捡起来，收进梦魇的深处。
lines.en: Picked up, tucked deep into the nightmare.

lines.zh: 这颗亮珠子，比猎物安静多了。
lines.en: This bright bead is quieter than prey.

lines.zh: 拾取只是顺手，追杀才是正事。
lines.en: Picking up is a side note; the hunt is the main thing.

lines.zh: 珍珠的光，照不穿第三层的暗。
lines.en: The pearl's light can't pierce the third layer's dark.

lines.zh: 我收下它，然后继续缩短距离。
lines.en: I take it, then go back to closing the gap.

lines.zh: 锁定你了，八格之内别想藏。
lines.en: Locked on you—no hiding within eight blocks.

lines.zh: 你一出现，我的范围就活了。
lines.en: The moment you appear, my range comes alive.

lines.zh: 目标确认，距离开始倒数。
lines.en: Target confirmed; the distance starts counting down.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我的猎场里。
lines.en: Where you stand is right in my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，现在轮到你感觉我。
lines.en: I see you; now it's your turn to feel me.

lines.zh: 锁定完成，靠近就是你的错。
lines.en: Lock complete; approaching is your mistake.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我的范围比腿长。
lines.en: You can't escape; my range is longer than legs.

lines.zh: 新猎物，老规矩：越近越疼。
lines.en: New prey, old rule: the closer, the more it hurts.

lines.zh: 你的气息被我咬住了。
lines.en: I've bitten onto your scent.

lines.zh: 目标已定，暗影开始收拢。
lines.en: Target set; the shadow begins to close in.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头也在我的范围里。
lines.en: Don't look back—looking back is still inside my range.

lines.zh: 你进入八格的那一刻，就晚了。
lines.en: The moment you entered eight blocks, it was too late.

lines.zh: 锁定你，不需要靠近，只需要你靠近。
lines.en: I lock you on—no need to approach, just you approaching.

lines.zh: 猎物确认，杀意随距离上调。
lines.en: Prey confirmed; killing intent scales with proximity.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的范围就跟着动。
lines.en: Move an inch, and my range moves with you.

lines.zh: 目标到手，接下来只剩缩短。
lines.en: Target acquired; all that's left is closing in.

lines.zh: 还差几步，我的力量正在涨。
lines.en: A few steps left; my power is rising.

lines.zh: 你退，我进，距离始终在我手里。
lines.en: You retreat, I advance—distance stays in my grip.

lines.zh: 八格之内，你每一步都在喂我。
lines.en: Within eight blocks, every step feeds me.

lines.zh: 别停，停下来我就贴上来了。
lines.en: Don't stop; if you do, I'll be right on you.

lines.zh: 暗影跟着你，我也跟着你。
lines.en: The shadow follows you, and so do I.

lines.zh: 你越慌，距离缩得越快。
lines.en: The more you panic, the faster the gap shrinks.

lines.zh: 我不用冲刺，慢慢来就够了。
lines.en: I don't need to sprint; slow is enough.

lines.zh: 你现在的位置，疼得还不够。
lines.en: Where you are now, the pain isn't enough yet.

lines.zh: 再近一格，你就明白差别了。
lines.en: One more block closer, and you'll understand the difference.

lines.zh: 你越近，我的毒越浓。
lines.en: The closer you come, the thicker my venom.

lines.zh: 梦魇第三层没有死角，只有距离。
lines.en: The third layer has no blind spots—only distance.

lines.zh: 你绕圈也没用，范围是圆的。
lines.en: Circling won't help; my range is a circle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收网，你慢慢发慌。
lines.en: I slowly pull the net; you slowly panic.

lines.zh: 距离每减一格，我就更凶一分。
lines.en: Each block lost makes me a bit fiercer.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，就是在给我加力。
lines.en: Standing there is feeding me power.

lines.zh: 别以为八格很远，对我刚好。
lines.en: Don't think eight blocks is far; for me it's just right.

lines.zh: 我不追快，我追近。
lines.en: I don't chase fast; I chase close.

lines.zh: 你的退路，正在被我一步步吃掉。
lines.en: Your escape route is being eaten step by step.

lines.zh: 暗影越浓，你离疼越近。
lines.en: The thicker the shadow, the closer you are to pain.

lines.zh: 再走一步，我们就只差一层暗影了。
lines.en: One more step, and only a layer of shadow remains between us.

lines.zh: 这一下，是距离送给你的。
lines.en: This one is a gift from the distance.

lines.zh: 贴得越近，我打得越狠。
lines.en: The closer you are, the harder I hit.

lines.zh: 八格之内，都是我的攻击范围。
lines.en: Within eight blocks is all my attack range.

lines.zh: 别躲，你躲不出这个圈。
lines.en: Don't dodge; you can't dodge out of this circle.

lines.zh: 暗影一推，你就退了三步。
lines.en: One shadow shove, and you're three steps back.

lines.zh: 你靠近我，就是在讨打。
lines.en: Coming close to me is asking for a hit.

lines.zh: 这一击带着第三层的重量。
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of the third layer.

lines.zh: 我的爪子够不着，范围够得着。
lines.en: My claws can't reach—my range can.

lines.zh: 痛吗？再近点会更痛。
lines.en: Does it hurt? Closer will hurt more.

lines.zh: 距离越短，力道越长。
lines.en: The shorter the distance, the longer the force.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就追半步。
lines.en: You step back one; I chase half a step.

lines.zh: 暗影扫过，你的位置就空了。
lines.en: The shadow sweeps by, and your spot goes empty.

lines.zh: 这不是冲刺，是范围在咬你。
lines.en: This isn't a dash—it's my range biting you.

lines.zh: 你站在边缘，也照样挨打。
lines.en: Standing at the edge, you still get hit.

lines.zh: 一击不够，就让距离再缩一格。
lines.en: One hit isn't enough; let the distance shrink one more block.

lines.zh: 我的攻击不需要碰到你。
lines.en: My attack doesn't need to touch you.

lines.zh: 你越慌，我的范围越准。
lines.en: The more you panic, the more accurate my range.

lines.zh: 别怪我没提醒，靠近就是疼。
lines.en: Don't say I didn't warn you—closeness is pain.

lines.zh: 这一下，是暗影替你数的。
lines.en: This one, the shadow counted for you.

lines.zh: 退吧，退到八格外再喘气。
lines.en: Retreat—catch your breath beyond eight blocks.

lines.zh: 梦魇第三层，我来了。
lines.en: The nightmare's third layer—I have arrived.

lines.zh: 暗影裂开，我从中走出。
lines.en: The shadow splits, and I step out.

lines.zh: 八格之内，从现在起归我。
lines.en: Within eight blocks, from now on, it's mine.

lines.zh: 第三层又多了一个猎手。
lines.en: The third layer has gained another hunter.

lines.zh: 我不急，距离会替我动手。
lines.en: I'm in no rush; distance will do the work.

lines.zh: 光亮落在远处，我先收着。
lines.en: A glint lands far off; I'll keep it in mind.

lines.zh: 黑暗让我站稳，也让我靠近。
lines.en: Darkness steadies me and brings me closer.

lines.zh: 新来的，站远点也没用。
lines.en: Newcomer, standing far won't help.

lines.zh: 我现身了，你的范围到了。
lines.en: I've appeared; your range has arrived.

lines.zh: 梦魇的风，替我报了到。
lines.en: The nightmare wind announced my arrival.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，你慢慢怕。
lines.en: I come slowly; you fear slowly.

lines.zh: 第三层的暗，今天格外浓。
lines.en: The third layer's dark is especially thick today.

lines.zh: 火焰烧过来，暗影替我挡了几分。
lines.en: Fire burns in; the shadow takes some of it for me.

lines.zh: 摔下来有点闷，但距离没摔断。
lines.en: The fall stings, but the distance isn't broken.

lines.zh: 水灌进来不舒服，我更想回到暗里。
lines.en: Water pouring in is unpleasant; I'd rather return to the dark.

lines.zh: 炸得我晃了晃，范围还稳着。
lines.en: The blast rocks me, but my range holds.

lines.zh: 远处飞来的东西，也挡不住我靠近。
lines.en: Things flying from afar can't stop me from closing in.

lines.zh: 魔法打在身上，像暗影里的一阵风。
lines.en: Magic strikes me like a gust in the shadow.

lines.zh: 饿不饿无所谓，我只在意距离。
lines.en: Hunger doesn't matter; I only care about distance.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我抖了抖，继续走。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I shudder and keep walking.

lines.zh: 虚空拉扯我，可第三层还没放我走。
lines.en: The void pulls at me, but the third layer hasn't let me go.
